public.method1: PCI is dimensionless intensity perceived by an observer. It is not safety, flow speed or probability and can exceed 1.0.
public.method2: The initial model is Weighted Analog. Numeric output requires at least three eligible numeric labels, three distinct observation days, three valid analogs, N_eff of at least two, same-Site evidence and sufficient environmental data. Model verification is in P5. No number is shown when gates fail.
public.method3: Overall PCI and Peak events are separate labels. Historical weak/normal or unspecified records are not converted into numeric labels. All data from the same WITA date share a validation fold.
public.method4: Morning and afternoon medians require six valid slots out of eight. Missing windows are not filled by interpolation. Aggregate support is the lowest support among displayed valid slots.
public.method5: Files are read from one immutable release and verified by hash. Official D+1 snapshots require separate verification of the WITA 20:00 cutoff and actual persistence time. A latest release is not automatically an official D+1 forecast.
public.modelPending: Observation, environmental evidence and field verification pending
public.withdrawn: Withdrawn record. Prior Git history remains.
public.staleHelp: Generated more than 36 hours ago. Previous data, not a current prediction.

public.graphHelp: The x axis is dive start time. The y axis is representative PCI for the following 60 minutes. Higher means stronger overall perceived intensity. Gaps mean no prediction, not zero or no current. Lines connect valid slots starting 30 minutes apart.
public.pciReferenceMarker: 1.0 is the perceived level of the September 19 reference event. It is neither a safety threshold nor an upper bound. This curve does not indicate vertical current.

environment.title: Environment overview
environment.help: Each metric retains its unit. Points show supplied times; gaps are not interpolated. Daily ranges cover available samples only. Directions have no min/max range. u/v are regional eastward/northward model velocities, distinct from local currents and wall projections. Temperature is modelled. Wind and wave directions follow provider conventions. Moon data is display-only astronomy, independent of PCI features and forecast snapshots.

public.multiSiteCurveHelp: Compare Site curves · selected Site highlighted · no cross-Site average
public.environmentComparisonHelp: The main table compares supplied samples at 12:00 WITA on the selected date. Current u/v uses the Site reference depth; wind direction and wave height use surface provider values. Missing timestamps, duplicates, rejected quality, and unapproved redistribution remain unavailable. Direction uses north at 0° and east at 90°, following the provider wind convention.
